_note: Thomas, 2026-09-06: 'do round 1: GB' — the first round of the thin-coverage direction. The UK had 13 nodes, all of them local-government finance plus the Blue Book, the census, population estimates and a dead-obligation EDP inventory: a G7 economy with no CPI, no labour market release, no balance of payments, no public sector finances and no central bank publication in the graph. This round mints the national core and the statutory spine (Code of Practice for Statistics, and the Statistics and Registration Service Act 2007 that requires it), and wires two nodes that were already present but unconnected to each other (population estimates -> Census 2021). Every url and every evidence_url was raw-verified HTTP 200 before use and every quote read live from the cited URL in the cloud sandbox. One exception, recorded on the edge: bankofengland.co.uk serves a JavaScript shell to a text fetcher, so the Monetary Policy Report quote was read from the Bank's own February 2026 PDF on the same host. obr.uk 403s to both this session's networks, so the OBR forecast is left as a lead, not minted.

reports.title: Consumer price inflation, UK
reports.description: The UK's monthly consumer price inflation bulletin, carrying the Consumer Prices Index including owner occupiers' housing costs (CPIH), the Consumer Prices Index (CPI) and the Retail Prices Index (RPI). The index the Government's 2% inflation target is defined on.

reports.title: Living Costs and Food Survey
reports.description: The UK's household budget survey: an annual survey of household spending, which with national accounts household final consumption expenditure underpins the calculation of the consumer price inflation weights. ONS's own Consumer Prices Indices Technical Manual names it as one of the two major sources of information for the weights.

reports.title: Labour Force Survey
reports.description: The UK's continuous household survey of labour market activity, and the source of the International Labour Organization measure of unemployment that the monthly labour market bulletins are built on. Its own QMI: "The main labour market statistics are published in our monthly Labour market overview, UK bulletins".
reports.cadence_note: Continuous survey; datasets released quarterly, with the headline estimates carried monthly by the Labour market overview bulletin.

reports.title: Labour market overview, UK
reports.description: The UK's monthly headline labour market bulletin — employment, unemployment, economic inactivity and earnings — first published in April 1998. Draws its unemployment measure from the Labour Force Survey rather than the administrative Claimant Count.

reports.title: United Kingdom Balance of Payments — The Pink Book
reports.description: The UK's annual balance of payments compendium: current account, capital and financial accounts and the international investment position. Produced in accordance with the IMF's Balance of Payments Manual sixth edition and in line with the UK Statistics Authority's Code of Practice for Statistics.

reports.title: Public sector finances, UK
reports.description: The UK's monthly public sector finances bulletin — borrowing, debt and the main fiscal aggregates — produced jointly with HM Treasury. All statistical aggregates in the bulletin are defined using national accounts concepts and rules, compiled with reference to ESA 2010 since 2014.

reports.title: Monetary Policy Report
reports.description: The Bank of England Monetary Policy Committee's quarterly report on inflation and the outlook for monetary policy, setting out the Committee's projections against the Government's 2% target for the 12-month increase in the Consumer Prices Index.

reports.title: Code of Practice for Statistics
reports.description: The statutory code the UK Statistics Authority is required by section 10 of the Statistics and Registration Service Act 2007 to prepare, adopt and publish; official statistics assessed against it are designated National Statistics. UK statistical releases state compliance with it as their quality basis.
reports.cadence_note: Revised occasionally rather than on a cadence — s.10(2) of the Act: 'The Board may at any time revise the Code'. Edition 2.1 is the current text.

reports.title: Statistics and Registration Service Act 2007
reports.description: The Act that established the UK Statistics Authority as a non-ministerial department and set the statutory framework for UK official statistics, including the requirement at section 10 that the Board prepare, adopt and publish a Code of Practice for Statistics.

_dropped.why: NOT FOUND 2026-09-06. The obvious edge — the UK LFS measures unemployment on the ILO definition, which is the ICLS resolution — is not supported by any ONS document read this round. The Labour Force Survey QMI (read live, HTTP 200) says only 'the International Labour Organization (ILO) measure of unemployment', naming the agency and not the ICLS resolution: PLAYBOOK section 7, 'naming the agency is not naming the artefact'. A site-scoped search for 'International Conference of Labour Statisticians' / 'ICLS' on ons.gov.uk returned no current methodology page, only the 2009 LFS User Guide Volume 5 PDF, which was not opened. The edge is almost certainly real and citable — it needs the document that names the resolution, which is a research task, not a modelling one.
